subfindings.defect: Unquantified near-normal incidence is used as exact 45-degree incidence, and exact normal emergence is used only approximately while an exact TIR threshold is applied.
subfindings.basis: The d493 reflected/normal routes were exact-normal routes. An unspecified nonzero angular deviation changes the relevant internal incidence. An index only infinitesimally above the exact sqrt(2) threshold supplies no declared angular margin for all the stated near-normal rays.
subfindings.notClaimed: This does not deny the existence of the exact-normal path within a neighborhood; it identifies that the written near-normal condition does not justify the stated exact angle and criterion as scoped.

subfindings.defect: The long-face trace names an unspecified short face but applies the newspaper-side index n_b to that encounter.
subfindings.basis: With per-face outside media unresolved, the first encountered short face must be identified before its index is used. The conditional path can be restricted to a first hit on the lower newspaper-facing short face; another short face cannot silently use n_b.

subfindings.defect: The oblique two-face branch uses an undeclared theta_c for a common outside medium without declaring the higher-prism-index domain.
subfindings.basis: The d493 branch explicitly used m>1. In Q5 the surrounding medium is not inherited from Q4, so the water-specific critical angle cannot serve as an unstated generic definition. Define common n_e, require n_g>n_e, and bind theta_c=arcsin(n_e/n_g) for this branch.

requiredChanges: Use exact-normal entry/viewing/emergence language for the route whose angles are asserted to be exactly 45 degrees. Replace the near/nearly-normal wording in these assertions with normal wording; do not leave an unstated angular tolerance attached to an exact sqrt(2) criterion.

In the long-face normal-view paragraph, explicitly select the backward path whose first short-face encounter is the lower newspaper-facing face, then apply that face's n_b criterion. Keep the conclusion confined to that path, not every viewing direction.
In the oblique branch, explicitly introduce the common exterior index n_e and the domain n_g>n_e, and define theta_c=arcsin(n_e/n_g) before its inequalities.
